verified_findings.title: Signed remote plugin bundle URL exposed in diagnostics
verified_findings.summary: Baseline derived Debug, invalid input, request, response, size and redirect errors retained URL bytes; transport error chains and arbitrary echoed response bodies also exposed them. Candidate retains only parsed scheme and host, maps route errors to existing bounded safe_category, drops body error chains, omits untrusted response bodies, and redacts app_manifest in bundle Debug. Original request URL and policy/control flow remain intact.
verified_findings.trigger: A signed URL with credentials, path, query or fragment enters bundle validation or a failed real download; the error is formatted as Debug/Display or converted to JSON-RPC/analytics.

verification_requests.title: Matched real trigger and safety controls
verification_requests.summary: Existing PluginWorkload explicitly disables remote_plugin and _install uses marketplacePath. Add a bounded private remote plugin fixture using its owned peer/home and real plugin/install remoteMarketplaceName branch. Supply private authenticated workspace-enabled remote detail with release.bundle_download_url, capture owned app-server JSON-RPC error and telemetry/log surfaces plus peer request target; bind both binary builds and source bytes. Use debug-assertions loopback opt-in only in the isolated process, never real profile. Add native non-test diagnostic observation for ValidatedRemotePluginBundle Debug, Display, Debug and source-chain traversal where JSON-RPC cannot expose them.
verification_requests.reproduction: Matched baseline/candidate same synthetic URL with distinct userinfo, path, query and fragment canaries: malformed URL; connection failure; 4xx echo body; truncated body; oversized Content-Length and streamed overflow; redirect to signed second URL then failure or unsupported scheme; interrupted successful body. Require baseline leakage and candidate absence in every accessible diagnostic and chain; require safe scheme/host, category/status/cap and no server body. Verify peer receives exact signed path/query per hop, per-hop route enforcement, successful signed archive installation to private home, 100 MiB download/512 MiB extract caps, cancellation and cache-mutation/install lease behavior. Record unreachable branch separately rather than asserting coverage.
verification_requests.blocker: Worker assignment delegates builds and native observation to root; no tests or test scaffolding permitted.
